_comment: Sidecar for scene14_0.usd (a byte copy of scene6_0.usd: same table, same dome). Two cubes and two trays laid out for the SIMULTANEOUS dual-arm demo, matching cutamp/scripts/dual_arm_demo.py exactly -- one cube/tray pair on each side of the bimanual YAM so neither arm has to reach across the other. Poses are world metres (box `pos` is the centre); the table-top collider surface is at z=0.0451. Used by tools/replay_dual_plan.py.
